sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Hafiz Shahbaz Arif, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Kalyan Shankar, A.P.P.
 For O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Mrityunjay Kumar, Mr. Amardeep, A
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
4 01-12-2025
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner who is husband of opposite party No. 2 apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the dispute between the parties has already been resolved through the process of mediation vide Mediator's Report dated 04.11.2025 and terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by the parties is attached with the Mediator's Report kept at Flag 'B'.
4. Learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 does not dispute the contention made on behalf of the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.84774 of 2024(4) dt.01-12-2025 5.

In view of the fact that the dispute between the parties has been resolved, this anticipatory bail is allowed and it is ordered that in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from Md. Sagir Akhtar vs The State Of Bihar on 1 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105046863/
1 today, let the above-named petitioner be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khagaria in connection with Mahila P. S. Case No. 39 of 2022, subject to the conditions laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.
